DMSE.MissilePartDef.label: tandem shaped-charge warhead
DMSE.MissilePartDef.description: A tandem high-explosive anti-tank charge in the class of the AGM-114K. The precursor charge defeats reactive armour and the main jet carries the damage inside the target, so the blast radius is small but the damage is concentrated.

DMSE.MissilePartDef.label: blast-fragmentation warhead
DMSE.MissilePartDef.description: A blast-fragmentation charge in the class of the AGM-114M: a heavier case and a pre-fragmented sleeve trade penetration for a wider lethal radius against infantry and light structures.

DMSE.MissilePartDef.label: thermobaric warhead
DMSE.MissilePartDef.description: A metal augmented charge in the class of the AGM-114N. The fuel cloud burns rather than fragments: a small blast, but searing burns and fires that are far worse inside a room or bunker than in the open.

DMSE.MissilePartDef.label: kinetic blade warhead
DMSE.MissilePartDef.description: An inert mass with pop-out blades in the class of the AGM-114R9X. There is almost no explosive filler: the round kills the creature it hits and leaves the surroundings largely intact, at the cost of any real blast effect.

DMSE.MissilePartDef.label: inertial guidance
DMSE.MissilePartDef.description: A cheap strap-down inertial unit. No seeker, no terminal guidance and no cross-layer reach. Aim points follow a circular normal distribution around the target map center; it does not lock buildings or units.

DMSE.MissilePartDef.label: imaging infra-red seeker
DMSE.MissilePartDef.description: An imaging infra-red seeker that locks the hottest enclosed room if it is at least 15°C above the outdoors, and otherwise the largest creature on the target map. Fire-and-forget: no operator, no line of sight and no laser needed.

DMSE.MissilePartDef.label: semi-active laser seeker
DMSE.MissilePartDef.description: A semi-active laser seeker that homes on the most recent laser designation your faction has painted on the target map. The tightest dispersion of any seeker in this class, but there has to be a designator on the ground.

DMSE.MissilePartDef.label: millimetre-wave radar seeker
DMSE.MissilePartDef.description: A fire-and-forget millimetre-wave radar seeker in the class of the AGM-114L Longbow. It locks the hostile building with the largest footprint, or the largest hostile creature if no hostile buildings exist by itself, with no designator, no operator and no clear weather required.

DMSE.MissilePartDef.label: no payload
DMSE.MissilePartDef.description: No secondary charge. The warhead alone has to be enough, which keeps the missile light and the range long.

DMSE.MissilePartDef.label: secondary high-explosive charge
DMSE.MissilePartDef.description: A small secondary charge that detonates after the warhead, widening the damage radius a little.

DMSE.MissilePartDef.label: fragmentation sleeve
DMSE.MissilePartDef.description: An external pre-fragmented sleeve wrapped around the warhead. It sprays dense fragments over the impact area, badly wounding exposed infantry, but the extra mass costs a quarter of the missile's range.

DMSE.MissilePartDef.label: chaff dispenser
DMSE.MissilePartDef.description: A dispenser of chaff bundles and radar-absorbing streamers. When an enemy fire-control radar locks this missile, the dispenser can break the lock once per bundle; the bundles are a limited, one-way resource and do not make the missile quieter before the first lock.
